clock_scope.shutdown_duration_ms: Test-controller process.hrtime.bigint immediately before cli.stop (SIGTERM) through child exit and stdio pipes close; excludes later stopped-listener probe.
clock_scope.phase_elapsed_ms: Production CLI process.hrtime.bigint relative to its first reportShutdown callback; original producer values unchanged. Restore may initiate closing before SIGTERM; phase values are not re-zeroed or converted to HTTP/poll time.
clock_scope.sample_context: Functional bounded shutdown qualification; not a quiet-load throughput or p99 SLO benchmark.

result.lease_scope: Actual BACKEND_OWNER_RELEASED phase after SQLITE_CLOSED, process exit code0/signalnull, and independent new CLI PID startup. Workspace lease FD release is not separately timestamped by these B4 receipts; no invented lease-state field.
